# Japan Research Office

> Source-linked English intelligence from Japanese public, industry, corporate and patent sources for overseas business teams.

Official website: https://japanresearchoffice.com
Contact: hiroaki@japanresearchoffice.com
Language: English
Operator: Hiroaki Tsuboi, Japan

## Core services

- Industrial Signal Desk: https://japanresearchoffice.com/industrial-signal-desk.html
  Monitoring of Japanese data-centre, power-grid, semiconductor, permit, subsidy, construction, policy and infrastructure signals.
- Patent Intelligence: https://japanresearchoffice.com/patent-intelligence.html
  Defined-scope patent landscapes, monitoring, source-linked datasets and analytical reports with human review.
- AI Research Service: https://japanresearchoffice.com/ai-research-service.html
  Structured English research on Japanese markets, companies, technologies, regulations and industrial developments.
- Custom Research: https://japanresearchoffice.com/custom-research.html
  Defined-scope research designed around a client question, source set, geography, sector and deliverable.

## Evidence and limitations

Outputs are based on identified sources and use source links where available and legally accessible. AI may support collection, classification, translation and drafting; human review is applied to source traceability, factual consistency and uncertainty labelling. Outputs are informational and do not constitute legal, patent-law, financial or investment advice. Illustrative samples are not client results.
